title: Command catalog af/command-catalog@1
$comment: What `af help --json` and `af help COMMAND --json` print (ADR-0247): every visible command of the scope's subtree, generated from the clap definition the binary parses, with each runnable command's effects from the effects table. Hidden commands and the --help flag are not listed.

af_version.description: The version of the af that printed the catalog.

scope.description: The command the catalog starts at, as typed: `af` for the whole tree.

commands.description: The scope's command first, then every visible command below it, depth first in definition order.

when.description: null: always. Otherwise the condition that turns the effect on: the flag as typed (`--apply`) or a short phrase naming one.

path.description: The command's words after `af`; empty for `af` itself.

runnable.description: Whether the command runs: one without subcommands, or a namespace that takes arguments of its own and does not require a subcommand (`af`, `af review`, `af storage`).

subcommands.description: The names of its visible subcommands, in definition order.

effects.description: What a runnable command may do; null for a namespace that only groups commands.

value_names.description: The placeholders `--help` prints for its value; empty for a flag.

global.description: Whether its subcommands accept it too.

env.description: The environment variable that supplies it, when one does.

heading.description: The `--help` section it is listed under; null for the default one.

effects.description: What the command may do, never a promise that it will. Housekeeping every command shares is not listed: telemetry, the storage sweep after a run, the release check's schedule, a pinned release installed on demand, and the lazy registration of the repository's Project and checkout.

tokens.description: free: never calls a model. charges: may dispatch model Workers whose tokens are charged against a budget.

charges_when.description: With charges: the condition under which it charges; null when any run may. Always null with free.

state.description: store: a Task Store or a review Campaign's Store. files: files outside af's own state, in the repository, a worktree, a branch or a directory or file the command names. machine: af's machine-local state, the Provider and Project registries and Project Stores, configuration, installed releases, shell completions and man pages, telemetry and caches. remote: something off this machine, the gate branches and draft pull request of a Remote Check.

need.description: login: a person completes a Provider's official login, at a private terminal or through the host's private channel. approval: a developer's signature over an exact decision payload, made outside af. terminal: an interactive terminal, for a screen or an editor.
